finalResult.nextParagraphText: “No, you need to use the exact words that refer to the god,” Minaga said. “Of course, the actual words won’t be the same due to translations and whatnot, but the meaning of the title or name used has to be exact. Especially when it’s people I’m already mentally aware of who do it.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “That’s also my understanding,” the Sword Saint agreed.
